summary: One church (Our Lady of Fatima worship site name is only the parish's subtitle). Both November issues print the same box: Sat 8 AM, 5 PM, 7 PM Spanish; Sun 7:30, 10, 12 Spanish; Mon-Fri 6:45; confession Mon 6:30-7 PM and Sat 8:30-9 AM, 4-4:45 PM. Dated: Nov 16 Mass of Remembrance, Thanksgiving 9 AM, Fri Nov 27 Mass moved to 8 AM. Open: Wednesday Adoration start (bulletin 7:30 vs website 8:30) and whether Thanksgiving's 6:45 AM is cancelled.

slots.rationale: R28/C8: the bulletin's box and its adorers notice (p1, p4, both issues) give 7:30 AM; the homepage, whose Mass times otherwise match exactly, gives 8:30 AM. Leaning to the bulletin as presentation-bvm-cheltenham s10 and st-thomas-the-apostle-glen-mills s13 did: four current bulletin printings against one website line. Hard because 7:30 is only 45 minutes after the 6:45 Mass starts, and the site was read later (Nov 28).

slots.rationale: R17 records a cancellation only when stated; 'cancelled' isn't printed. Leaning per precedent our-lady-of-mount-carmel-doylestown s15 and our-mother-of-good-counsel-bryn-mawr s21: the notice gives the day's Mass and, in the same box, tells readers the next day's daily Mass time, so the 9 AM reads as Thursday's daily Mass. Against: st-joseph-warrington s13 left the weekday slot alone.
